clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1.   Scope - Requirements for mild steel and brass cup, ruler and square hooks and  screw eyes.

clauses.title: Types –    a) Shouldered cup hooks
clauses.text: 2.   Types -    a) Shouldered cup hooks b) Shouldered ruler hooks c) Shouldered square hooks d) Plain cup hooks e) Plain ruler hooks f) Plain square hooks

clauses.title: Screw Eyes shall be
clauses.text: 2.1 Screw Eyes shall be of One Type Only.

clauses.title: Designation – Shall be
clauses.text: 3.   Designation - Shall be based on type, length, and screw designation No. of the fitting. For example, shouldered cup hook of length 25 mm and of screw designation  No.5. shall be designated as "Shouldered cup hook 25×No. 5"

clauses.title: Finish – Hooks and
clauses.text: 5. Finish - Hooks and eyes shall be finished bright.
